lem-adjudicate-00232ac8c49e-stable-unive.title: Stacks Project, Rlim of abelian groups
lem-adjudicate-00232ac8c49e-stable-unive.statement: For a countable inverse system of abelian groups, the derived limit is represented by the product-difference complex in degrees zero and one. Its first derived-limit group vanishes for a Mittag–Leffler system, in particular for a system with surjective transition maps.
lem-adjudicate-00232ac8c49e-stable-unive.hypotheses: A countable inverse system of abelian groups; the vanishing assertion assumes the Mittag–Leffler condition. In this application the groups are the first homotopy groups of the derived mapping tower, and step 1.1 supplies surjective transition maps.
